_comment: Site gazetteer: site_id -> name + WGS84 position, used to give FHIR Location
resources a `position` for the GIS layer. IoT telemetry and public-health
envelopes carry a site_id but no coordinates, so without this their Locations
would be unmappable. Citizen-survey envelopes DO carry coordinates and those
COORDINATES BELOW ARE APPROXIMATE DEMO VALUES for the pilot cities, not
surveyed station positions. Replace with the real OAH station gazetteer
before presenting any of this as authoritative.
